topics.correction: `explanation`માં નાટકનું શીર્ષક 'પારખું' અને નરરત્નનું વાક્ય 'પારખું કરવા નીકળ્યો. પારખું થઈ ગયું.' બંને સાથે ટાંકીને પૂછવું કે નરરત્ન કોનું 'પારખું' કરવા નીકળ્યા હતા, અને છેલ્લે ખરેખર કોનું 'પારખું' થઈ ગયું — શબ્દ એ જ છે, પણ એનું વજન બદલાઈ ગયું છે.

chapter_level: Roman-script English code-switching (staff, compounder, trade secret, research, invention, dental surgery, allopathy, revolution, naturalteeth, fertilizer manure, process, cases, daughter, average, surcharge collector, Hard facts, and the full English exclamations) runs through nearly every stage-beat (T4, T5, T7, T8) and is the single biggest L2 comprehension barrier in this chapter — gloss it at first use in each topic it appears in; never delete, translate, or 'correct' it, since it is printed text the same as any Gujarati line.

The printed speaker-tag/name inconsistencies are all as-printed, not extraction errors: 'ડૉકટર' (no ક્ટ conjunct) throughout dialogue tags versus 'ડૉ પીયૂષ'/'ડૉ. પીયૂષ' elsewhere; 'મનમોહનદાસ' versus the MCQ's short form 'મનમોહન'; 'નરરત્નમણિરાવ' in the પાત્રો box versus 'નરરત્ન' as the running speaker tag. No topic's authored prose may treat these as mistakes to fix or silently normalise to one spelling.

The chapter's whole comic engine is boast-then-puncture, run twice (once on મનમોહનદાસ, once on નરરત્નમણિરાવ) — no topic before M2.S6.T9 may resolve or foreshadow the SECOND ચોટ (કે 'નરરત્ન' ખરેખર સસરો છે) before its own beat; each ચોટ must land only in the topic where it is printed.

The comedy runs on a man's unemployment and his own boasting (T4, T6, T7 especially) — every topic must teach the irony of the pretence being punctured, and never let the tone read as contempt for the character, per natak_ekanki.md's own std-9 ch-9 sensitivity note.
